[RDSC.6a.2.6] A service is identified by its name alone ([LIMP.5.3.1]), so
an artefact carries one `ServiceDef` atom per service. The compiler must not
emit a `ServiceDef` whose `name` is empty, nor two whose `name` is the same,
from one module or from several ([LCRS.14.9]). `module_id` attributes the service
to the module that declared it and takes no part in its identity.
